purpose: Execution-plan step 14: measured document-cost and run-count decisions

protocol.freshness: Each retained row executed every document task; zero reused suites. The first sample of each arm is retained. OS/filesystem caches were not flushed.
protocol.projection: Both arms use the current scripts/lib/gate-timeline.mjs gateCriticalPath; task duration is work, scheduler gaps are waiting.
protocol.scope: Before rows were measured during this work order before its final changes; they are not a checkout of the activation base. The comparison measures this bounded interval and does not isolate a parse-cache treatment.
protocol.overhead: Six passing measurement gates plus the retained failed after-document attempt; the final handoff document gate is additional and excluded from these medians.

limits: One host and one serial series per arm; no causal speedup claim.
The document parser and cache were not replaced; observed work and waiting include other changed fixture and evidence inputs.
Per-component medians do not sum to the critical-path median because components overlap and median paths may differ.
